notes: Background: large US-based ecommerce logistics platform. Heavy seasonal spikes (holiday windows) and frequent promo-driven surges.
Primary objective: reduce live-agent chats by 40-60% through automated deflection + high-confidence agent-assist suggestions; maintain or reduce average handle time.
Traffic profile: ~120k inbound conversational messages/day, peak concurrency ~6k open chats during promos. Typical short turns, many repetitive order/status queries.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 latency < 250ms for generation path, p50 < 120ms for cached responses; throughput target to sustain 6k concurrent sessions with burst capacity.
Cost sensitivity: target unit cost <= $0.05 per deflected conversation (including embedding/LLM costs). Interested in batching, KV/prefix caching, and quantized model variants to hit economics.
Model preferences: open-models preferred for cost control; willing to test quantized 8-bit and 4-bit variants. Want ability to fallback to smaller, cheaper model for low-confidence responses.

Routing/fallback needs: prefer smart routing by intent (fast path for status/order lookup using embeddings + retrieval; generative path for troubleshooting). Automatic fallback to deterministic templated reply when confidence < threshold.
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML SSO required, SOC 2 compliance mandatory, audit logs for conversation edits, KMS integration for keys, US-region data residency for PII.
Integration footprint: Zendesk + internal order API + Redis cache + Kafka event stream. POC will include a webhook connector and sample replay tooling.

POC plan (6 weeks): week1 - Zendesk webhook + sample ticket ingest; week2 - prompt templates + retrieval index; week3 - model A/B (quantized vs baseline) + load test; week4 - tool-calling flows (order status, cancel, refund) + safety rules; week5 - SLA/observability checks; week6 - business review + go/no-go.
Success metrics for POC: deflection rate, accuracy of suggested agent actions, cost-per-deflection, latency under 95th percentile spikes, false escalation rate.
